prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints (+3.0% to +6.0%), interactive wait screen tips/flows (+4.6% to +5.1%), preset customization fallback flow (+8.0%), and story screen sequence reordering (+2.9%) were helpful.
Most wait screen info updates, hints outside of sign-in, and sign-in step reordering showed no clear effect.
Layout changes and new desktop screens showed no clear effect or significantly hurt performance (down to -27.8%).
Specific copy changes frequently hurt performance (up to -13.9%) or showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated positive impacts for failed or harmful tests while underestimating wins like story sequence reordering and interactive waiting flows.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -1.2% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, hint: -0.1% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +2.6% over 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -0.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -4.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -3.9% over 3 test(s)
- finish, layout: +1.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -14.4% over 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +1.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.5% over 5 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +3.1% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.3% over 1 test(s)

- sign_in: 80.2%, median 3s / mean 567s

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Upload Sample Preview Flow: Adds an interactive sample preview gallery on the photo upload screen showing how different photo types render into desktop pets. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest completion rate (62.7%) and high mean time (1017s), with 3 support emails reporting custom pet generation failures.)
1: [home, new_screen] Waiting Phase Activity Mini Screen: Inserts a lightweight pet care mini-activity screen right before the long rendering wait step to keep users engaged while assets compile. (why: Home wait step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; engaging users upfront reduces drop-offs.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Pet Sync Status Hint: Displays an explicit status hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets auto-sync to their account. (why: Sign-in support has 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
3: [home, notification] Background Generation System Notification Option: Adds an opt-in toggle to notify users via desktop notification when pet rendering completes so they can minimize the app safely. (why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off or impatience while app is minimized.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Compact Grid Layout: Switches the choose path screen layout to compact mode for faster evaluation of companion options. (why: Choose path mean duration is 514s despite a median of 8s, indicating long-tail friction for undecided users.)
5: [adoption, hint] Generation Processing Fallback Hint: Adds a hint on photo upload detailing automatic fallback options if custom photo processing experiences errors. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)

scores.note: High drop-off step supported by user emails; interactive preview flows align with historical wins.
Interactive wait flows perform well, though adding new screens carries risk.
Sign-in hints consistently boost conversion (+3.1% avg) and direct support emails validate issue.
Targeted at long wait times, but OS notification option has limited prior test data.
Layout redesigns historically underperform or hurt conversion (-4.4% on this step).
Strong evidence for problem area, but hints outside sign-in have shown no positive effect.
